about: Shared scenario vectors for manual dashboard-row dismissal (Keep reading / On Deck / New-on-deck / In-progress reading lists). Canonical semantics live in dashboard-rows-spec.md section 'Row dismissal'. Both repos (komga-reader app LibraryRepository + komga/ShabbyFork ShabbyforkDashboardDao) must assert these. Bump 'version' on ANY change; each suite asserts the version it was written against, so a one-sided edit fails the other repo's build. Paired with dashboard-rows-vectors.json (the 'newDrop' decision), which versions independently.
decisionDefinition: latest = max(readDate for books where readDate != null); dismissed = dismissedAt != null && (latest == null || latest <= dismissedAt). Strict: a read STRICTLY after dismissedAt resurrects (un-hides); a read equal to dismissedAt does not. 'readDate' is the read-progress LAST-READ instant (set/updated when a book is opened in the reader), not the completion date. Identical function for kind=SERIES and kind=READLIST; it runs over the item's books either way.

fields.kind: SERIES (item is a series; books = the series' books; suppresses Keep reading + On Deck + New-on-deck) or READLIST (item is a reading list; books = the list's books; suppresses In-progress reading lists). Does not change the decision, only which row the suppression applies to.
fields.dismissedAt: instant the user dismissed the item, ISO-8601; null = never dismissed
fields.books[].readDate: read-progress LAST-READ instant for that book (updated on open/read); null = never opened
fields.expectedDismissed: canonical answer: is the item currently hidden from its row? Both implementations must return this.

vectors.name: never_dismissed
vectors.description: No dismissal recorded. Always shown regardless of reads.

vectors.name: dismissed_no_reopen
vectors.description: Dismissed; the only read predates the dismissal. Stays hidden.

vectors.name: dismissed_never_opened
vectors.description: Dismissed; no book in the series has ever been opened (all readDate null). latest == null -> stays hidden.

vectors.name: reopened_after_dismiss
vectors.description: Dismissed, then a book opened later. Read strictly after dismissedAt -> resurrected (shown again).

vectors.name: reopen_strict_tie
vectors.description: A read whose instant exactly equals dismissedAt. Strict comparison -> does NOT resurrect; stays hidden.

vectors.name: multi_book_one_reopened
vectors.description: Several books; one opened after the dismissal. Any one reopen resurrects the whole series (we take the max readDate).

vectors.name: readlist_dismissed_quiet
vectors.description: Reading list dismissed; no book in the list opened since. Stays hidden from In-progress reading lists.

vectors.name: readlist_reopened_after_dismiss
vectors.description: Reading list dismissed, then a book in the list opened later. Same predicate as SERIES -> resurrected.
